title: Prove the HTTP adapter in CI without a live model host
narrative: The local inference host is offline, but a pull request still needs green CI. Nubble wants the OpenAI-compatible path proven from a cassette — a recorded reply replayed through the real HTTP client — so merges do not depend on LAN reachability.
implementation:
`OpenAICompatStrategy` implements Chat Completions HTTP for reason-lane backends. CLI universe `cli:infer` via `CliInstrumentor` / `CliInferRunner` runs that strategy so cassette replay exercises the real client path and the same EventLog baseline as other one-shot runs.

Covers: offline CI / OpenAI-compat smoke.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `cassette_smoke.yaml`: nonempty assistant text, positive cost units, exact baseline EventLog types. Cassette `response.json`. Live: `MECHA_STORY_BACKEND=live`.
